nodes.label: AI Companion Linux portability audit
nodes.norm_label: ai companion linux portability audit
rationale: Diagnose before fixing because the failure surface spans undeclared platform contracts. [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-10-01 - audit-ai-companion-di-arch-linux [ses_f0732c855ffe3kI3xk46FrYEA2].md:L06191] Alasannya dua kalimat: scope-nya melintasi empat kontrak platform yang tidak dideklarasikan di kode (XDG GlobalShortcuts portal identity, KGlobalAccel component naming, WebKitGTK transparent-surface mapping, input-injection binary + `/dev/uinput`), dan tidak satu pun punya automated coverage. Karena itu diagnosis harus precede fix — plan saya audit-first, bukan patch-first.

Run the full suite before deploying, because a regression makes the deploy pointless. [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-10-01 - audit-ai-companion-di-arch-linux [ses_f0732c855ffe3kI3xk46FrYEA2].md:L16452] So P1 = run the full Rust lib suite + full frontend suite on vps-bcb. That's F7, and it's the single highest-value next action because it validates 8 commits of shared-code changes. [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-10-01 - audit-ai-companion-di-arch-linux [ses_f0732c855ffe3kI3xk46FrYEA2].md:L16498] Tapi kalau P1nemuke regresi, P2 jadi sia-sia — dan worse, install runbook bisa jadi lebih rumit dari yang saya kira. Verifikasi dulu, baru deploy.

nodes.norm_label: audiocuecoverage register keyed by file:line
rationale: Re-key the register instead of deleting exclusions, because deleting would reintroduce the gap the contract prevents. [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-10-01 - audit-ai-companion-di-arch-linux [ses_f0732c855ffe3kI3xk46FrYEA2].md:L21779] membuang exclusion itu akan merusak.** Empat kontrol yang sengaja senyap akan balik jadi work queue sebagai gap tak terakuntansi, dan itu persis yang應該 contract ini cegah. Jadi re-key, bukan hapus.

Key the audio register by handler or data-testid because line-number keys die again on the next insertion. [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-10-01 - audit-ai-companion-di-arch-linux [ses_f0732c855ffe3kI3xk46FrYEA2].md:L21787] dan register audio yang akan **mati lagi** di commit berikutnya yang menyisipkan baris di atas kontrol terdaftar. Re-key benar tapi akan berulang — solusi tahannya key by handler atau `data-testid`, bukan nomor baris.

nodes.rationale: The app must be quit via the tray because there is no SIGTERM handler to preserve session bookkeeping. [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-10-01 - audit-ai-companion-di-arch-linux [ses_f0732c855ffe3kI3xk46FrYEA2].md:L22817] Quit Snipset lewat tray.** Runbook Step 0 mensyaratkan app tidak sedang berjalan sebelum swap binary, dan **tidak ada SIGTERM handler** — kalau saya kill, tidak ada `SESSION_END` dan boot berikutnya mencatat `PREVIOUS_SESSION_ABNORMAL`. Tidak ada CLI quit command.
